apiError.networkBlocked: Something blocked the request before it reached Grindr

apiErrorDisplay.retryableFailure: The server ran into a problem

appError.connectionFailed: Couldn't connect to Grindr. Check your internet connection and try again.
appError.webPage: The server returned a web page instead of data
appError.titledWebPage: The server returned a web page: "{{title}}"

cloudflare.title: Grindr blocks your requests
cloudflare.description: Cloudflare protecting the Grindr API is currently blocking your requests because of suspicious activity.
cloudflare.advice: You can also rotate request parameters using the button below.

network.title: Something blocked the request before it reached Grindr
network.description: A VPN, DNS filter, captive portal, or a school or work network may have answered instead of Grindr, or an edge in front of the Grindr API turned the request away.
network.advice: Otherwise, switch to another network, or rotate request parameters using the button below.

requestBlocked.vpnHint: If you use a VPN, try disabling it.
requestBlocked.dontShowAgain: Don't show again in this session

rateLimited.description: Grindr turned away our attempts to refresh your session. Wait a moment and try again.

refused.title: Grindr refused your session
refused.description: Grindr wouldn't refresh your session. Try again, and if it keeps happening, copy the error and report it.

unreachable.title: Can't connect to Grindr
unreachable.description: We couldn't reach Grindr to refresh your session. Check your internet connection and try again. If this keeps happening, copy the error and report it.

sessionError.expired: Your session expired — please sign in again

banned.title: Your account is banned
banned.description: Grindr has banned this account. You can't sign in until the ban is lifted.
banned.descriptionWithReason: Grindr has banned this account ({{reason}}). You can't sign in until the ban is lifted.

ageVerification.title: Age verification required
ageVerification.description: Grindr requires you to verify your age before continuing. Complete it in the official Grindr app, then sign in again. Open Grind does not bypass age verification.

restricted.title: Account restricted
restricted.description: Your account is currently restricted and can't be used. Check the official Grindr app for details.
